zh: 删除只会让剩下的序列变短，最长递增子序列不会变长。所以“删 t 次后是否仍满足要求”随 t 单调：某个 t 不行，之后的都不行。
单调性意味着可以二分最大的可行删除次数。判定某个 t 时，跳过删除时刻不超过 t 的位置，对剩余元素求最长严格递增子序列的长度，再和 minOrder 比较。
先记录每个原下标是第几次被删除的；判定函数用耐心排序求 LIS（维护每种长度递增子序列的最小末尾，用二分查找替换）；如果 t=0 都不可行就输出 −1；否则在 0 到 n 之间二分出最大的可行 t 并输出。
en: Removing elements only shortens the remaining sequence, so its longest increasing subsequence never grows. Whether t removals still meet the requirement is therefore monotone: once some t fails, every larger t fails too.

Monotonicity lets you binary search the largest feasible number of removals. To test a given t, skip every position whose removal time is at most t, compute the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence of what remains, and compare it with minOrder.

Record for each original index the step at which it is removed; the test computes the LIS with patience sorting, keeping the smallest tail of an increasing subsequence of each length and replacing by binary search; if even t=0 fails, print −1; otherwise binary search the largest feasible t between 0 and n and print it.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Record the removal time of each original index. For a given number of removals t, filter out the removed positions and compute the LIS length with patience sorting; feasibility is monotonically non-increasing in t, so check t=0 first, then binary search for the largest feasible t.

## Proof of correctness

Removing elements only shrinks the set of subsequences, so if some t is infeasible, every later t is infeasible as well. In patience sorting, tails[l] is the smallest last value of an increasing subsequence of length l+1 in the scanned prefix; replacing by binary search preserves this invariant, so the length of tails is exactly the LIS. An exact test plus binary search over a monotone boundary gives the maximum number of removals; an infeasible start returns −1 separately, as this site's protocol specifies.

## Complexity

Time O(n log²n), space O(n).
